title: rpl_dao_build.c sequence counters advanced outside dm->lock — lost-update TOCTOU
description: build_dao_mut writes dao_sequence/path_sequence/last_dao_* (:260-265) and build_dao_copy_with_lifetime writes dao_sequence (:334) after caller released lock (snapshots :279-283/:298-301/:324-326). Two builders read seq N both write N+1 → lost increment reuses DAOSequence across transmissions degrading DAO↔ACK correlation (RFC 6550 §7.1). Move snapshot+build+advance inside held lock or locked advance_sequences helper.
